items.title: BLAST R6 Major Osaka: Everything you need to know
items.summary: The BLAST R6 Major Osaka is Rainbow Six Siege's third international event of Year 11, following the BLAST R6 Major Salt Lake City and the Rainbow Six Siege Esports World Cup 2026, and the first played on Asian soil since Tokoname in November 2019. The tournament runs November 6 to 15 with a play-in stage November 6-7, Swiss Stage November 8-11 and playoffs November 13-15, played to a 3,600 capacity crowd at ATC Hall with tickets already sold out. 20 teams take part, 12 seeded directly into the Swiss Stage and 8 in the play-in, and the format matches the BLAST R6 Major Salt Lake City. Osaka is a final chance to earn SI Points for the Six Invitational 2027, where only FaZe Clan are currently qualified.

items.title: Rainbow Six Siege - Wasteland Circuit race drones today
items.summary: Ubisoft's official launch coverage for Wasteland Circuit, the first drone racing event in Rainbow Six Siege. The limited-time event runs September 23 to October 12, with players racing drones along custom-built tracks filled with obstacles, shortcuts and high-speed challenges, collecting item and boost balloons. The Wasteland Circuit Collection offers dieselpunk-themed cosmetic items to unlock.

items.title: New Twitch Drop and Badge Available During the Wasteland Circuit Event!
items.summary: A limited Twitch Drop accompanying the Wasteland Circuit launch, granting an exclusive drone skin and a Twitch chat badge to celebrate the event.

items.title: Ubisoft reveal Sao Paulo as Six Invitational 2027 location
items.summary: Ubisoft and BLAST revealed Sao Paulo as the host city of the Six Invitational 2027, the second Six Invitational held in Brazil after the 2024 edition that saw w7m esports win in the grand final against FaZe Clan. The event runs February 1 to 14, 2027 with the Finals from February 12 to 14 at the Suhai Music Hall in the south of the city, which has a maximum capacity of a little over 9,000. Ticket prices run from R$40 to R$700 across single-day, three-day ground floor and balcony passes.

items.title: Rainbow Six Siege's new game mode Wasteland Circuit to be released on September 23
items.summary: Preview coverage for Wasteland Circuit before its launch. The mode is a drone racing game mode comparable to Mario Kart, where players find random items while racing that affect other drones, including Fenrir's smoke, Goyo and Tachanka's fire, Bandit and Kaid's electricity and Mozzie's pests. Wasteland Circuit is open from September 23 until October 13. The mode was first introduced during the Operation Split Fire reveal, held immediately before the Rainbow Six Siege Esports World Cup 2026 grand final.

items.title: Play Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Split Fire Today
items.summary: Ubisoft's launch day announcement for Year 11 Season 3, confirming the Villa targeted map update that relocates the first floor Living Room/Library bombsite to the basement, balancing updates for Kali and Dokkaebi alongside smaller changes to Lion, Echo and Kapkan, modernized Stadium Alpha, Stadium Bravo and House, and the mid-season Legend Division Ranked playlist.

items.title: New Twitch Drop for Operation Split Fire!
items.summary: A Twitch Drop for the Operation Split Fire season granting the Smells Like Burning weapon charm. The drop runs from September 1 at 6:00AM PT to September 15 at 6:00AM PT, unlocked by watching 3 hours of gameplay on official Rainbow Six Siege channels or select partners.

items.title: Gamescom Livestream Recap: The Growing Siege Universe, Noor Deep Dive, and What's Next
items.summary: Recap of the Rainbow Six Siege Community Checkpoint streamed live from Ubisoft's Community Lounge at Gamescom. Highlights include the connection between Siege and the newly announced Rainbow Six Tactics narrative, the backstory of Noor (Ahmed Noor, son of Jamal Murrad, a former Rainbow and Unit 777 Operator), the confirmation that Siege returns to four new Operators per year starting in Year 12, and a look at the future of the game as it settles into its new update cadence.

items.title: Rainbow Six Tactics Revealed: A Turn-Based Tactical Experience
items.summary: Ubisoft announced Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Tactics during Opening Night Live at Gamescom: a single-player, turn-based tactical game set in the Rainbow Six universe and taking place alongside Siege's timeline. Players step into the role of Six, assigning up to four Operators to a squad. The game includes 15 Operators with unique abilities, specialized gadgets and distinct skill trees, mission types such as Hostage Rescue, Bomb Disposal and Target Elimination, and over 45 diverse locations worldwide. A Breach Planning mode lets players execute synchronized assaults, and bases of operations can be upgraded between missions. Available to wishlist for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, GeForce Now, Blacknut and PC through the Ubisoft Store, Steam and the Epic Games Store.

items.title: FaZe Clan become Rainbow Six Siege Esports World Cup 2026 champions
items.summary: FaZe Clan won the Rainbow Six Siege Esports World Cup 2026 by taking down FURIA 3-1, with FURIA temporarily stopping their run with a maximum overtime win on Fortress before FaZe lifted the trophy with a 7-5 win on Lair. Jaime 'Cyber' Ramos was the best player of the grand final, averaging a rating of 1.40 across the four maps with a grand final K-D of 53-29 and a 1.10 KPR. It is FaZe Clan's fourth international Tier S trophy after the Six Sweden Major and two Six Invitationals, making them the first team to win every possible Rainbow Six Siege trophy on the international stage.

items.title: Rainbow Six Siege - Operation Split Fire: New Operator Noor, 3v3 Arcade Mode, Wasteland Circuit Event, and More
items.summary: Ubisoft's season reveal for Operation Split Fire, announced during the Esports World Cup. The season launches September 1 with Noor, an Egyptian two-speed two-armor Defender whose Horus Lance Launcher burrows into shields and surfaces and then spouts flames, a limited-time 3v3 Arcade mode running September 8-21, the Wasteland Circuit event running September 23 to October 12, the mid-season Legend Division playlist for Champion-level players, the targeted Villa map update, modernized Stadium Alpha, Stadium Bravo and House, and operator price decreases for Ram, Skopos and Denari.

items.title: Your Twitch Drops Guide For The BLAST R6 Stage 1 2026
items.summary: Ubisoft published a Twitch Drops guide for the R6 Regional Leagues Stage 1 2026, detailing the exclusive in-game rewards available by watching the competition on the official Rainbow Six Twitch channels.

items.title: Ranked 3.0 Update
items.summary: Ubisoft's full breakdown of the Ranked 3.0 overhaul launching with Operation System Override on June 2. Ranked 3.0 removes hidden MMR so skill is truly rank, and introduces Placement Matches (5 per season, with increased Rank Point gains and no squad restrictions), a Competitive Rewards track awarding 2 points for a win and 1 for a loss with 15 reward tiers from 2500 Competitive Coins at 10 points through 5000 Competitive Coins and headgear at 150 points, squad restrictions, and changes to the Champion rank. The post-match report now clearly displays RP changes, and Demotion Shield protections remain active.

items.title: FaZe Clan have won the Six Invitational 2026 after two infinite overtime maps
items.summary: FaZe Clan became the first team to win back-to-back Six Invitational editions, lifting the hammer with a 3-1 victory over Team Secret in Paris. FaZe took Consulate and Bank convincingly, Team Secret responded with a 12-10 win on Fortress that tied the record for most rounds played at a Six Invitational grand final alongside the 12-10 on Coastline at the 2019 final, and FaZe closed out the series with a 10-8 win on Border. Only FaZe Clan, KDS, soulz1, Cyber and coach RafadeLL Oliveira have won a Major, a Six Invitational and the Esports World Cup.
